title: IBM Expands AI and Quantum Research With IIT Bombay and IISc
key_facts: IBM expanded collaborations with IIT Bombay (since 2018) and IISc (since 2021)
IIT Bombay work: Indic and sovereign language models, multimodal AI, AI infrastructure, knowledge retrieval
IISc work: agentic systems, AI for applications, quantum algorithm development
Quotes from IBM Research India and both universities
No funding amounts or timeline given
quote_evidence: IBM today announced expansions of two long-standing research collaborations in India
With IISc, IBM researchers will continue a collaboration that began in 2021
notes: Press release republished; no independent comment. Event dated 3 Oct per URL.
